docs.title: lhd-data
docs.text:
Lightweight xarray-native tools for LHD analyzed data.

from lhd_data import load_diag

ds = load_diag("thomson", 150482)

docs.title: CLI How-To
docs.text: The cache CLI is for reproducible local analysis downloads. It uses a small TOML recipe and stores downloaded EG files in a .gitignored local cache.

docs.title: Install
docs.text:
Activate the project environment and install the package:

& "$env:USERPROFILE/.venvs/lhd-data/Scripts/Activate.ps1"
python -m pip install -e ".[dev,docs]"

docs.title: Edit The Recipe
docs.text:
Example:

cache_dir = "local/lhd_data"

shots = [
    193772,
    193773,
]

diags = [
    "nbpwr_tot_temporal",
    "fircall",
    "thomson",
]

Core diagnostics:

  • nbpwr_tot_temporal: NBI port-through power
  • fircall: line-averaged density
  • thomson: Te and ne profiles

The current Figure1.ipynb and Figure2.ipynb workflows also use wp, bolo, ha1, ha2, and ha3.

docs.title: Run Downloads
docs.text:
lhd-cache local/cache.toml

Files are cached as:

local/lhd_data/<shot>/<diag>_<subshot>.dat

For example:

local/lhd_data/193772/thomson_000001.dat

Use --refresh to redownload files that already exist:

lhd-cache local/cache.toml --refresh

Use --fail-fast to stop on the first failed diagnostic:

lhd-cache local/cache.toml --fail-fast

docs.title: Load Cached Data
docs.text:
from lhd_data import load_cached_diag, load_cached_shot

ds = load_cached_diag("thomson", 193772)
shot_data = load_cached_shot(193772)
